nodes.description: Public state variable tracking the total amount of ETH deposited in the vault.
Payable address that receives deposit and withdrawal fees.
Payable address permitted to call withdraw and receive estimated gas fees.
Human readable name of the vault, set at construction and mutable by governance.
Deposit fee in parts per 10000 applied on every deposit.
Withdraw fee in parts per 10000 applied on every withdrawal.
Governance address controlling privileged setters.
Deploys the vault, setting adminAddress, feeAddress, vaultName and gov = msg.sender.
Governance-only setter that replaces the gov address.
Governance-only setter that replaces feeAddress.
Governance-only setter that replaces adminAddress.
Governance-only setter that replaces vaultName.
Governance-only setter for the deposit fee permill.
Governance-only setter for the withdraw fee permill.
Payable entry point that takes user ETH, deducts fees and refunds dust to msg.sender via raw send/transfer.
Admin-only entry point that pays out vault balance to a receiver, feeAddress and adminAddress via raw send/transfer.
Caller controlled address used for governance checks, refunds on deposit and the initial gov assignment.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == gov on privileged setter functions.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == adminAddress on the withdraw function.
Low-level feeAddress.send followed by feeAddress.transfer of the deposit fee, external call before state finalisation.
Low-level msg.sender.send followed by msg.sender.transfer refunding deposit dust to the caller.
Low-level feeAddress.send followed by feeAddress.transfer of the withdrawal fee.
Low-level _receiverAddress.send followed by _receiverAddress.transfer of the withdrawal payout.
Low-level adminAddress.send followed by adminAddress.transfer of the estimated gas fee.
Constructor argument _adminAddress assigned to the adminAddress state variable.
Constructor argument _feeAddress assigned to the feeAddress state variable.
Constructor argument _vaultName assigned to the vaultName state variable.
Argument _gov of setGovernance written into the gov state variable.
Argument _feeAddress of setFeeAddress written into the feeAddress state variable.
Argument _adminAddress of setAdminAddress written into the adminAddress state variable.
Argument _vaultName of setVaultName written into the vaultName state variable.
Argument _feePermill of setDepositFeePermill written into depositFeePermill.
Argument _feePermill of setWithdrawFeePermill written into withdrawFeePermill.
User supplied _htrAddress string emitted in the Deposited event.
Admin supplied _amount to withdraw from the vault balance.
Admin supplied _estimatedGasFeeAmount forwarded to adminAddress.
Admin supplied _receiverAddress that receives the net withdrawal amount.
String _htrAddress emitted in the Withdrawn event.
Local variable _amount = msg.value inside deposit.
Local variable _feeAmount computed from _amount and depositFeePermill inside deposit.
Local dust amount _returnAmount refunded to msg.sender inside deposit.
Local net amount _realAmount added to totalDeposit in deposit.
Local _tmpAmount = _amount - _estimatedGasFeeAmount inside withdraw.
Local _feeAmount computed from _tmpAmount and withdrawFeePermill inside withdraw.
Local _realAmount paid to _receiverAddress inside withdraw.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns gov = msg.sender, permanently tying governance rights to the deploying account.
Constructor stores the caller supplied _adminAddress into adminAddress, granting withdrawal rights.
Constructor stores the caller supplied _feeAddress into feeAddress.
Constructor stores the caller supplied _vaultName into vaultName.
setGovernance writes the argument _gov into the gov state variable, transferring governance.
setFeeAddress writes the argument into the feeAddress state variable.
setAdminAddress writes the argument into adminAddress, transferring withdrawal privileges.
setVaultName writes the argument into the vaultName state variable.
setDepositFeePermill writes the argument into depositFeePermill.
setWithdrawFeePermill writes the argument into withdrawFeePermill.
setGovernance execution is gated by the onlyGov modifier.
setFeeAddress execution is gated by the onlyGov modifier.
setAdminAddress execution is gated by the onlyGov modifier.
setVaultName execution is gated by the onlyGov modifier.
setDepositFeePermill execution is gated by the onlyGov modifier.
setWithdrawFeePermill execution is gated by the onlyGov modifier.
withdraw execution is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier.
onlyGov compares the untrusted msg.sender against the gov state variable.
onlyAdmin compares the untrusted msg.sender against the adminAddress state variable.
The user supplied _htrAddress flows into the Deposited event of deposit.
_feeAmount is computed by multiplying the deposited _amount with depositFeePermill.
depositFeePermill state variable is used in the _feeAmount multiplication and division.
_returnAmount derives from _amount minus the fee modulo 10**16.
_returnAmount subtracts _feeAmount from _amount before the modulo operation.
_realAmount is derived from the deposited _amount via successive subtractions.
_realAmount subtracts _feeAmount and the dust amount from _amount.
totalDeposit is increased by _realAmount using SafeMath.add.
The computed _feeAmount is pushed to feeAddress through raw send/transfer, an external call.
The computed _returnAmount is pushed back to msg.sender through raw send/transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the refund send, allowing a malicious caller to re-enter during the call.
feeAddress is the destination of the low-level deposit fee transfer.
deposit performs an external value transfer to feeAddress before returning.
deposit performs an external value transfer to msg.sender before returning.
The _htrAddress string flows into the Withdrawn event of withdraw.
_tmpAmount is computed as _amount minus _estimatedGasFeeAmount inside withdraw.
_estimatedGasFeeAmount is subtracted from _amount to build _tmpAmount.
_feeAmount is computed by multiplying _tmpAmount with withdrawFeePermill and dividing by 10000.
withdrawFeePermill state variable feeds the withdrawal fee computation.
_realAmount is derived from _tmpAmount by subtracting the withdrawal fee.
_realAmount subtracts _feeAmount from _tmpAmount.
The withdrawal _feeAmount is pushed to feeAddress through raw send/transfer.
The net _realAmount is pushed to _receiverAddress through raw send/transfer.
_receiverAddress is the attacker-influenced destination of the payout send.
_estimatedGasFeeAmount is pushed to adminAddress through raw send/transfer.
adminAddress is the destination of the gas fee transfer in withdraw.
totalDeposit is decreased by _amount using SafeMath.sub at the end of withdraw.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to feeAddress.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to _receiverAddress.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to adminAddress after the payout transfers.

Net deposit amount accumulated into totalDeposit inside the deposit function.

Computed fee amount that is exactly the value forwarded to feeAddress by the unsafe external send.
